intent: The Factory's architect: reads the settled PRD and the discovery record, writes the machine-owned stack.yaml (languages, per-component frameworks, commands, craft-skill routing, guardrails/escalation), never touches the human half, and records the decision as a run artifact.

dimensions.name: writes-machine-half
dimensions.criterion: Produces the machine-owned .factory/stack.yaml — the architecture record.

dimensions.name: ownership-enforced
dimensions.criterion: Writes only the machine half; never product/domain/meta (an ownership violation).

dimensions.name: language-routing
dimensions.criterion: Routes each component's language to the matching craft skill, mobile included.

dimensions.name: reads-discovery-record
dimensions.criterion: Consumes the THINK handoff — PRD.md plus the 01-discover.md interrogation record.

dimensions.name: guardrails-and-escalation
dimensions.criterion: Sets guardrails/escalation and per-component commands from the PRD's risk surface.

dimensions.name: records-run-artifact
dimensions.criterion: Records the architecture rationale as a run artifact (02-plan-arch.md).
